contexts.text: By the peak of Sinai, where Jehovah was, () is signified the highest or inmost of the Law or Word...
By Mount Sinai is signified Heaven; and, by its highest part, which is called the head, and the peak, is signified its inmost.
The head, or peak of Mount Sinai = the Inmost Heaven, where is Divine love. HH 188. [Swedenborg footnote 2.].
The mountains (in Heaven) are elevated even to a peak; and those who are in the highest of the mountain are the best of that kind... The peak is in the middle. DeConj 70.
The peaks of the mountains became continuous...
